memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: There, in the presence of the Lord your God, you and your families shall eat and shall rejoice in everything you have put your hand to, because the Lord your God has blessed you. You are not to do as we do here today, everyone doing as they see fit, since you have not yet reached the resting place and the inheritance the Lord your God is giving you. - Deut 12:7-8 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
Notice the atmosphere God describes for worship: "you and your families shall eat and shall rejoice." Worship in God's presence was not meant to be gloomy or fearful, but joyful. Families gathering, sharing meals, rejoicing together in God's blessing — this was the picture. God delights to be worshipped by glad hearts. Coming into His presence was meant to be a celebration, an overflow of joy in response to His goodness.

We sometimes think of worship and reverence as somber, heavy things. There is a place for awe and seriousness before a holy God, but Scripture also shows us that true worship brims with joy. To be in God's presence, enjoying His blessings with those we love, is one of life's greatest delights. God is not a harsh master to be dreaded but a good Father in whose presence there is "fullness of joy" (Ps 16:11).

This joyful worship points forward to something wonderful. The shared meals in God's presence foreshadow the great feast to come, when God's people from every nation will sit at the table together in His presence forever (Rev 19:9). And even now, we are invited into the joy of the Lord through Christ. Worship is not a duty to endure but a delight to embrace. When you come to God, come with joy — not manufactured cheerfulness, but the deep gladness of being welcomed into the presence of a good and generous God. Let your worship be full of rejoicing.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
- Do I approach worship as a joyful celebration or a somber duty?
- What blessings from God can I rejoice in today?
- How does the coming feast in God's presence shape my worship now?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Father, thank You that worship in Your presence is meant to be full of joy. You are not a harsh master but a good Father in whose presence is fullness of joy. Help me come to You with glad rejoicing, delighting in Your goodness and Your welcome. Amen.
